title: SDLC Session Gate
description: Runtime session state for the SDLC workflow gate. Persisted at .sdlc/memory/session-gate.json.

gate_status.description: Whether the gate is open (writes to protected paths allowed) or closed.

card.description: Active board card ID (e.g. RPG-42). Empty when gate is closed.

stage.description: Active SDLC stage controlling which paths are writable.

opened_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the gate was last opened.

last_agent.description: ID of the last agent that updated the gate (e.g. 'implementer', 'qa').

last_commit.description: Short hash of the last commit on the feature branch.

stage_started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current stage began.

meta.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for agent-specific context.
